title: Danfo Chase
summary: Tunde follows three marked public routes while the Chief's runners follow behind. Stop for crossings and queue gaps, rejoin after detours, hear a passenger's source lead and preserve a time-stamped service slip.

stages.title: Very persistent passengers
stages.text:
A car follows Tunde away from the stop. Two of the Chief's runners keep pointing at his bus.
Passenger: Driver, do they have tickets?
Tunde: They have enthusiasm. It is not the same fare.

Keep to the marked public roads and safe stops. The people crossing and queuing still have right of way. Detours and missed bays can rejoin without losing a clue.
stages.summary: Follow the public route, stop at every marked waiting bay and preserve the passenger's source lead. The following car creates story pressure without a timed clue loss.

choices.label: Use the marked public route and keep the stops
Drive onto the pavement to get ahead
choices.hint: Keep the pavement for people. The marked public route has recoverable turns and safe stops.

stages.title: First leg · people before pursuit
stages.text:
Passenger: They are still behind us.
Tunde: The crossing is still ahead of us.

Brake in the lower-lane waiting bay before the crossing. Choose Wait until the marked route clears, then select a pace control again and continue to the final safe bay. Guided approach makes the same required stop.
stages.summary: Stop at the crossing waiting bay, explicitly wait for the marked route to clear, then continue and stop at the final bay. The following car never removes the need to yield.

choices.label: Read the first turn from the final safe stop

stages.title: A cousin has supplied a route
stages.text:
Passenger One: Left at the blue market board.
Passenger Two: My cousin says the other road is shorter.
Tunde: Your cousin owes this bus a map.

The marked left is direct. The public-road detour loops back after a short comic delay. Both rejoin the route with the same evidence opportunity.
stages.summary: Take the marked left or a recoverable public-road detour. Neither loses the passenger's clue.

records.title: First turn board
lines: Marked public route: LEFT at the blue market board

choices.label: Take the marked left at the blue board
Take the cousin's public-road detour and rejoin
Cut across the pedestrian space
choices.hint: Both public-road choices can rejoin. Pedestrian space is not a route option.

left_marked.text:
Passenger: The blue board was useful.
Tunde: It has applied for a seat on the route committee.
left_marked.summary: The marked left reached the next route cue directly.

cousin_detour.text:
Passenger: Driver, if this is the short road, why did I pack lunch?
Tunde: We missed a turn, not our whole future.

The bus follows the signed public-road loop and rejoins at the queue board.
cousin_detour.summary: The comic detour rejoins at the queue board without losing evidence, fares or progress.

stages.title: One landmark at a time
stages.text: Ask for the queue board and one clear direction. The passengers can disagree about the soundtrack after everyone arrives.
stages.summary: Use the queue board as the next shared landmark. Both earlier routes reach it.

choices.label: Ask for the marked queue board
Ignore the board and guess a private driveway
choices.hint: Use the marked public route. The queue board is the shared landmark.

stages.title: Second leg · a queue with a committee
stages.text:
Tunde: This queue has started its own neighbourhood.
Passenger: Does it have a chairman?
Tunde: It has three. That is why it is not moving.

Stop in the lower-lane waiting bay. Wait for the marked queue gap to clear, then choose a pace control again. Never squeeze between the queued vehicles or the people beside them.
stages.summary: Reach the queue waiting bay, choose the explicit wait action, then continue to the final safe stop. Guided approach also waits for your confirmation.

choices.label: Read the next public-road turn from the safe stop

stages.title: The road after the argument
stages.text:
The board marks the canal-side public road to the right. A second signed loop rejoins it. The footpath has no road sign because it is a footpath.
Passenger: I vote for the one with a road.
Tunde: A promising manifesto.
stages.summary: Use the marked right or its signed public-road loop. A queue gap never permits driving through pedestrian space.

records.title: Queue exit board
lines: Marked route: RIGHT to the canal-side public road
Alternative: signed public-road loop, then rejoin

choices.label: Take the marked right onto the canal-side road
Follow the signed loop and rejoin
Mount the kerb to avoid the queue exit
choices.hint: The two public-road options rejoin. Keep the kerb and footpath clear.

canal_right.text: The marked right takes the bus toward the public transport office.
canal_right.summary: The bus follows the marked road toward the public stop.

loop_rejoin.text:
Passenger: We have seen that wall before.
Tunde: It is a very popular wall.

The signed loop rejoins the same road toward the public transport office.
loop_rejoin.summary: The second detour rejoins the same road and keeps the passenger's source available.

stages.title: A passenger with a paper trail
stages.text:
Sikiru, a service-desk worker from the wedding, recognises the bag tag described by the passengers. He still has his service-slip copy. He offers to compare it at the public stop.
Tunde: At last, a passenger whose story has a reference number.

A service slip is a record to compare. Sikiru is not claiming to have seen every part of the bag's journey.
stages.summary: Arrange to compare Sikiru's retained service-slip copy at the next public stop. Keep its limited claim distinct from a complete eyewitness account.

choices.label: Agree to compare the slip at the next safe stop
Grab the paper while driving
choices.hint: Finish the marked route and stop first. The paper and its source are not going anywhere.

stages.title: Third leg · the public stop
stages.text:
The transport-office sign is ahead, beyond another crossing.
Passenger: A proper stop, driver.
Tunde: Even a dramatic arrival requires punctuation.

Stop at the crossing waiting bay, explicitly wait for it to clear, then continue to the final lower-lane safe bay. The source comparison happens after the bus stops.
stages.summary: Yield at the final crossing, then reach the marked public stop. No source comparison requires driving through people.

choices.label: Park at the public transport-office stop

stages.title: The audience takes a different road
stages.text:
At the busy public stop, the following car continues along the main road. The runners lose their place in the story for now.
Passenger: I would like a refund for the scenic route.
Tunde: You received two committee meetings and a landmark.

Let everyone leave through a clear aisle. Sikiru can show his slip with the bus parked.
stages.summary: The following car goes on. Keep the bus parked, clear the aisle and compare the offered paper.

choices.label: Clear the aisle and compare the offered slip while parked

stages.title: SR-18 has a time on it
stages.text:
Sikiru's copy is marked SR-18, 21:14, wedding service desk: assistance requested for Bisi at the caterers' room. It records a service request and time; it does not name the bag's owner or establish every event at the bus.
Tunde: The paper has fewer opinions than the passengers.

Keep the reference, timestamp and source together for the later comparison.
stages.summary: Retain SR-18's 21:14 service request for Bisi as a limited time/source record. The full bag sequence still needs the original and later accounts compared.

records.title: Service slip SR-18 · retained copy
lines: Time: 21:14 on the wedding service record
Scope: request/time record; not a complete account of the bag

choices.label: Keep the reference, time, source and limited claim together
Say the slip alone settles the whole bag mystery
choices.hint: The slip supports a service request and time. Compare it with the original and later accounts before reconstructing the full sequence.

stages.title: A copy with a source line
stages.text:
Sikiru agrees to a family-investigation copy while keeping his own paper. Keep unrelated contact details out of it. This agreement concerns this record; it does not grant permission to publish a later witness interview.

Choose a private source-labelled copy or a redacted source-labelled copy. Both retain the same service clue.
stages.summary: Keep a source-labelled private or redacted copy with Sikiru's agreement. Later testimony/public use still has its own consent decision.

choices.label: Keep a private source-labelled investigation copy
Keep a redacted source-labelled investigation copy

ngozi_record.text: Ngozi: The bag remains under its recorded custody. Bring the copied source, not a new theory about ownership.
ngozi_record.summary: Ngozi's bag custody remains unchanged while the slip joins the comparison.

joint_record.text: Ngozi: The joint bag record stays as it was. Add the service slip as a separate source.
joint_record.summary: The joint custody record remains unchanged; the service slip is a separate clue.

stages.title: One trip. One reference number.
stages.text:
Danfo Chase complete. The stopped crossings, queue gap and route choices are saved. Tunde gains three mastery once, and the copied service slip joins the journal. Detours did not remove the clue. Phone, portfolio opportunity, family disclosure and bag custody remain unchanged.

Ngozi and KC have an invitation to prepare for. Aso-Ebi Infiltration follows.
stages.summary: Tunde rejoined the public route, stopped for crossings and retained the source-labelled service slip. Three Tunde mastery and the service clue are awarded once, without StreetCoins. Aso-Ebi Infiltration follows.

choices.label: Save the route and service-slip copy
